svg.title: Dual RX 7900 XTX throughput: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 and GLM-5.3-Flash
svg.desc: Cold five-phrase retrieval on two RX 7900 XTX cards with a Radeon 8060S expert helper. DeepSeek EXL3 uses a 1,048,576-token allocation; GSQ-RCO, Maya-S and Maya-XS v2 use 524,288. Each quant has one eleven-point curve on the same prompt bytes; every point found all five phrases. GLM uses its own tokenizer and recorded capacities. Each horizontal tick doubles the input length.
